note: KD-only: the task loss is not backwarded at all. Adam(lr=1e-3), 2 fit batches, 8 held out.

raw_output.verdict: LEARNABLE: held out, freezing the backbone leaves 1.77x the residual error of the full arm.

interpretation.reachable: Yes, decisively. 94.4% reduction on the fit batches and 59.4% held out. The 2.5% movement seen at w=4.0 in the 10-epoch sweep was a weight-and-budget effect, not a capacity wall.
interpretation.generalizes: Yes. 59.4% held-out reduction is real transfer, not memorization -- though the fit/held-out gap is 7.1x, which is expected when fitting only 2 batches.
interpretation.projector_absorption: Not dominant, but present. The frozen-backbone arm still reaches 28.1% held out with 3 trainable tensors against 765. The backbone accounts for 53% of the held-out gain.
interpretation.verdict_margin: 1.77x against a pre-set 1.5x bar. Above the line but NOT by a comfortable margin; the threshold was a judgement call, so read the ratio, not the label.

caveats: Probe B optimizes the KD term ALONE with Adam(1e-3). P1 runs SGD(lr0=0.01) with KD at roughly a 10% gradient share. 'Reachable in principle' is not 'reached under P1's budget'.
2 fit batches and 8 held-out batches of coco128 at imgsz 256, on an untrained model (pretrained=False).
The absorb-factor (1.5) and learnable-threshold (20%) are author-set, not derived.
